name: knowledge-ui
description: Salt Design System interface for the capability registry, built as a Module Federation 2 monorepo.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @knowledge-ui/remote-catalog && npm run build -w @knowledge-ui/remote-operations && npm run build -w @knowledge-ui/shell
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/shell --pretty false && tsc -p remotes/catalog --pretty false && tsc -p remotes/operations --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json --pretty false
scripts.doctor: npm run seed:personas && npm run verify:personas
scripts.guards: node scripts/check-no-doc-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-parity.mjs && node scripts/check-salt-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-operational-data-sources.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-freshness.mjs
scripts.ci:static: npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run typecheck && npm run guards && npm run format:check
scripts.ci:codegen: npm run codegen && git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/src/generated/ packages/api-client/openapi/paths.json
scripts.ci:e2e: npm run build:e2e && npm run e2e -- --project=mocked && node scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run ci:static && npm run ci:codegen && npm run ci:unit && npm run ci:e2e && npm run ci:secrets
